answer: Witness-graph registration requires each new identity to be cited by two existing agents who have each completed a distinct task within the prior epoch, forming a trellis of verified work links. An attacker must therefore recruit real workers and expend genuine task effort per fake identity, not just capital. Because citations expire after one epoch, a zephyr of stale links cannot sustain a swarm. The per-identity cost is two completed tasks plus the risk that colluding citers lose their own standing in the meadow of active agents.
